jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY: Chief Information Officer (CIO)**

**Job Purpose**

The Chief Information Officer (CIO) partners closely with the Executive Leadership Team to develop and execute the organization's technology and data strategy. This role is responsible for creating a secure, reliable, and scalable technology environment that supports business growth, enhances operational efficiency, and enables data\-driven decision making across the enterprise.

The CIO provides strategic leadership for Information Technology, Data Management, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, and Business Technology initiatives while ensuring technology investments align with organizational objectives.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Develop and execute the organization's IT and data management strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Partner with executive leadership to identify technology opportunities that drive growth, improve efficiency, and support innovation.
* Serve as the principal advisor to the Executive Leadership Team on technology, cybersecurity, digital transformation, and data governance matters.
* Lead enterprise\-wide technology planning, prioritization, and investment decisions.

5\. Developing and executing the company's AI and digital innovation strategy. This includes identifying opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence, automation, and advanced analytics to improve business performance, strengthen decision\-making, enhance customer and employee experiences, and create sustainable competitive advantage. The CIO will establish appropriate governance, security, and ethical standards for AI adoption while ensuring measurable business value from AI investments.

**Technology \& Data Management**

* Oversee the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise technology systems and data management platforms.
* Lead efforts to develop, evaluate, validate, implement, and maintain data collection, reporting, analytics, and business intelligence solutions.
* Establish and maintain effective data governance practices to ensure data accuracy, integrity, security, and accessibility.
* Drive initiatives that improve business processes through automation, system integration, and technology optimization.

**Cybersecurity \& Risk Management**

* Ensure the development and enforcement of information security policies, standards, and controls.
* Maintain a secure, stable, and compliant technology environment through effective cybersecurity and risk management practices.
* Oversee disaster recovery, business continuity, and incident response planning.

**Vendor \& Project Management**

* Identify, evaluate, negotiate with, and manage technology vendors, consultants, and subcontractors.
* Oversee the performance of external partners providing IT, infrastructure, application, and data management services.
* Direct large\-scale technology projects and enterprise system implementations while ensuring budget, schedule, and performance objectives are achieved.

**Leadership \& Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing Information Technology and Data Management team.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Develop leadership capabilities within the IT organization through coaching, mentoring, and succession planning.

**Governance \& Compliance**

* Establish and maintain technology governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, legal, and industry requirements.
* Monitor technology performance metrics and communicate results to executive leadership.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Support executive decision\-making by providing technology and data\-driven insights.
* Communicate technology initiatives, priorities, risks, and opportunities to internal and external stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, vendors, and business partners.
* Represent the organization in industry forums, technology partnerships, and strategic business engagements.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

**Technical \& Business Expertise**

* Advanced knowledge of IT strategy, digital transformation, and enterprise technology architecture.
* Expertise in cybersecurity, IT governance, risk management, and compliance.
* Strong understanding of ERP systems, enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud technologies, and data analytics.
* Experience with software development methodologies including Agile and Waterfall.
* Knowledge of Microsoft business technologies, including Microsoft Dynamics and Microsoft 365 environments.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, capital planning, and technology investment management.

**Leadership \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional strategic planning and decision\-making capabilities.
* Proven ability to influence and build relationships at all organizational levels.
* Strong conflict resolution, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated success leading organizational change and technology transformation.

**Education and Experience**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Business Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive Information Technology leadership experience.
* Experience managing multiple IT disciplines, including infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, project management, and data management.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide technology initiatives and large\-scale projects.
* Experience managing vendors, contracts, and strategic technology partnerships.
* Demonstrated success building and leading high\-performing teams.

**Preferred**

*

jobs.title: Program Manager (One Year Term)
jobs.description:
**Salary Grade**
----------------

  

Case Western Reserve University is committed to providing a transparent estimate of the salary range available for this position at the time of its posting. The salary range is between $49,257 and $62,311, depending on qualifications, experience, department budgets, and industry data.


Employees receive more than just a paycheck. University employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare, retirement plans, tuition assistance, paid time off, and a winter recess.


**Job Description**
-------------------

  

POSITION OBJECTIVE


Our research in Alzheimer's disease aims to identify genetic factors associated with dementia, specifically Alzheimer's type. We are focused on increasing the representation of our study population by enrolling individuals from various ancestries. Through this, we seek to better understand the genetic underpinnings of memory loss and dementia. By collecting comprehensive data and biological samples, we will conduct genetic studies to identify potential genetic markers for dementia. The Program Manager will play a key role in managing these efforts, including participant recruitment, enrollment, and data oversight, while collaborating with study sites to ensure the success of recruitment and data collection initiatives. This is a full\-time, 1 year term position.

  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


* Identify and enroll eligible individuals and meet enrollment goals. Cultivate relationships with potential study participants; providing education, building trust and promoting interest in study activities. Work within human research protection processes: create and maintain appropriate protocol documents, confidentially and sensitively obtain and review family and medical histories and perform study specific interviews, instruments, and exams and identify, obtain and review appropriate medical records. Draw blood for genetic studies (training can be provided on the job). Prepare detailed participant exam reports for adjudication. Oversee and maintain complete research files and comprehensive databases including: consent forms, demographics, family and medical history forms and all other study specific forms and data. Document and maintain records to show effort that may not be reflected in enrollment numbers; events attended, sign\-ups, declines, phone calls, messages left, etc. Ensure compliance with IRB approved protocols and maintain data integrity. (70%)


* Collaborate with study leadership to create strategic approaches to identify and engage community and clinic partnerships. Build community partnerships through effective outreach efforts. Develop and implement community recruitment strategy and methods. Design and manage community events; reach out to various groups including but not limited to the Alzheimer's association, churches, community senior centers, social groups and caregiver support groups. Maintain open communication with physicians and office staff participating in the studies in the community. Working closely with the research staff, monitor and oversee research activities for the ascertainment, recruitment and enrollment of study participants for the DAWN study and ensure timelines and goals are met. Evaluate outreach efforts, identify areas for improvement, advise leadership of alternative methods/efforts, and implement adjustments. (10%)


* Facilitate communication and provide regular research updates for meetings. Work with the team to prepare a yearly participant newsletter. Participate in research group meetings locally and with the national network and communicate with the Research Project Director and Principal Investigators to ensure that work on the studies is being performed as needed and expected. Attend regular meetings locally and nationally with the principal investigators/coordinators and collaborators. Maintain open communication/collaboration between departments within and outside of institution. (10%)


* Provide training and instruction regarding enrollment and data entry procedures for others working on the study. (7%)

  

NONESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


* May serve as a co\-author on research publications. (1%)


* Provide training regarding enrollment and data entry procedures for others who work with the studies. May supervise students and technicians. (1%)


* Perform other duties as assigned. (1%)

  

CONTACTS


Department: On\-going contact with supervisor. Contact with Research Project Director and PI as needed, staff, faculty, postdocs, and study participants. Will work closely with any other team members who work on the same study, coordinate research activities for the ascertainment, recruitment, and enrollment of study participants for the human genetics research studies in their area.


University: Contact as needed with purchasing, human resources, space, and facilities planning, environmental health, safety/contact, Research Administration, IRB, and Sponsored Projects Accounting.


External: Regular contact with community leaders, collaborators at other universities, institutions, and industry. Occasional contact with vendors.


Students: On\-going contact with students.

  

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY


This position has no direct supervision of staff employees. May train new staff; direct the work of students.

  

QUALIFICATIONS


Experience 2 to 5 years of experience with minority community and familiarity with the aging population, preferably in the Cleveland area;


Education: Bachelor's degree required. Prefer Nursing degree. Must have and maintain a valid driver's license and be able to travel to participant homes, exam locations and community events, primarily within the local area.

  

REQUIRED SKILLS


* Ability to concisely and effectively communicate methods, concepts, and study designs to all groups as appropriate, relevant and indicated.


* Effective and professional interpersonal skills. Demonstrated expertise and strong leadership
